execution_claim: Function/assertion correspondence only; no PASS, execution or platform acceptance claim. Test/CI results must identify the tested commit separately. Platform skips are not successful execution.

disposition_legend.original_named_assertions: An original-named native case contains the corresponding assertions.
disposition_legend.named_native_case: Corresponding native lifecycle case, usually without the test_ prefix.
disposition_legend.aggregate_assertions: Assertions are represented in an explicitly referenced shared native test/corpus.
disposition_legend.native_transport_assertions: Interpreter/script transport is replaced by native command/payload; behavior assertions remain.

scope: Retained general theme features. External lifecycle policy and its dedicated tests are maintained by their provider; they are not part of this release or its execution counts.
